title: OmniPrep™ High Quality Genomic DNA Extraction from Nucleated Blood Cells
author: G-Biosciences
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.e54bg8w
materials: Allow the sample to cool to room temperature.

steps.title: Lyse nucleated blood
steps.instruction: Add 10 µl nucleated blood to a 1.5 ml microfuge tube containing 500 µl Lysis Buffer. For larger volumes, use a 15 ml tube with 1 ml Lysis Buffer per 10 µl blood and adjust other reagents proportionally (1 µl blood ≈ 1 mg tissue).

steps.title: Incubate lysate
steps.instruction: Incubate at 55–60 °C for 15 minutes (do not exceed 60 °C).

steps.title: Optional Proteinase K digestion
steps.instruction: Add 1 µl Proteinase K solution per 100 µl Lysis Buffer (optional) and incubate at 60 °C for 1–2 hours, inverting the tube periodically each hour.

steps.title: Extract with chloroform
steps.instruction: Add 200 µl chloroform and mix by inverting the tube several times.

steps.title: Phase separation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge 10 minutes at 14,000 × g; carefully transfer the upper aqueous phase to a clean microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: DNA stripping
steps.instruction: Add 50 µl DNA Stripping Solution and invert several times to mix.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA
steps.instruction: Add 100 µl Precipitation Solution and invert several times; a white precipitate should appear. If not, add 50 µl additional Precipitation Solution aliquots until a white precipitate forms.

steps.title: Isopropanol precipitation
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant to a clean tube, add 500 µl isopropanol, and invert 10 times to precipitate DNA. OPTIONAL: add 2 µl Mussel Glycogen as a DNA carrier.

steps.title: Pellet DNA
steps.instruction: Centrifuge 5 minutes at 14,000 × g and remove the supernatant.

steps.title: Ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Add 700 µl 70 % ethanol and invert several times; centrifuge 1 minute at 14,000 × g; decant or pipette off the ethanol wash.

steps.title: Dry pellet
steps.instruction: Invert the tube on a clean absorbent surface for several minutes to drain excess ethanol; do not let the pellet dry completely.

steps.title: Resuspend DNA
steps.instruction: Add 50 µl TE Buffer to the pellet and incubate at room temperature for at least 15 minutes to rehydrate (or 5–60 minutes at 55–60 °C to speed rehydration).

steps.title: Optional RNase treatment
steps.instruction: Add 1 µl LongLife™ RNase per 100 µl TE Buffer (optional).

steps.title: Store DNA
steps.instruction: Store DNA at 4 °C for short‑term; for long‑term storage keep at –20 °C or –80 °C. Typical yield: 2–3 µg DNA per 10⁶ cells.
